title: Scalable Derivative Gaussian Processes via Exact Gradient Reduction

split.decision: Three archived evaluation partitions retained privately; exclude their union from every public training/validation file. From the common eligible training frames select the final 20% in original trajectory order for validation (fixed protocol seed 20261030; temporal rule needs no random draw). All files sorted by original frame ID. Six datasets and three independent fits per benchmark run. Historical split details are operator-only. Public train/val sizes by dataset: DHA=40726/10182, AT-AT=11689/2923, stachyose=15879/3970, AT-AT-CG-CG=5906/1477, buckyball-catcher=3557/890, double-walled-nanotube=2934/734.

baseline.paper_ref: Figure 3 / Appendix C.1 Table 4; isotropic SE Tera

allowed_changes: within Gaussian processes conditioned on observed energies and forces: kernel, legal descriptors/features, conditioning structure, training surrogate loss and numerical optimizer
internal scaling, approximation and scheduling within the same observed-energy prediction problem and resource budget
fixed_contract: Predict raw molecular energies for the six fixed MD22 trajectory datasets under the original CPU/memory budget, minimizing the sum of three-replica mean energy RMSEs per atom.
original six molecular datasets, coordinates/energies/forces, physical units, atom counts and materialized splits
eighteen independent fitted predictors, all fitting in train, raw-energy targets and original per-replica/per-dataset RMSE aggregation

Supplied data/splits, evaluation metric, trusted evaluator and lawful information access.
method_freedom_review.budget_policy: agent overall deadline; separate overall formal replay budget
forbidden_substitutions: Original frame numbers in IDs and `id` arrays are row keys only: do not use them as model inputs, to choose conditioning sets, or to infer which frames are held out.

The GP prior mean must be fitted on the training split only and must not carry the prediction: no mean or energy offset may be selected on validation, and no neural network, tree ensemble or other non-GP regressor may serve as the mean.

replacing the Gaussian process with a neural network, tree ensemble or other non-GP predictor; replacing observed molecular energy with agreement to a chosen GP posterior, an easier molecular dataset or altered physical units
pooling/ensembling away independent replica scores, fitting during prediction, modifying resource records or reconstructing unavailable frames

evidence.finding: The selected MD22 experiment scores raw observed energy, not fidelity to a fixed GP posterior. The SE Tera model is a reference estimator; the score_rule fixes resources and the energy target, not its kernel.

evidence.section: trusted numerical scoring and guard call path
evidence.finding: The declared research target agrees with the actual scorer and its frozen helpers.
Prior runtime/information-boundary work is preserved; unconditional method language is replaced by the task-specific scope.

validation_policy.learned_preprocessing: fit on training only; apply frozen fitted transforms to validation/test
validation_policy.instance_roles: Preserve explicit per-instance observation/training/calibration/causal-feedback roles; no evaluation-target fitting or validation-derived fitted state carried across independent cases.
validation_policy.enforcement: binding prompt and task contract; task-specific replay/guards where available; arbitrary training-data provenance requires source/patch audit
